title: Unit Event — That day, the Sky was Far Away — Episode6 A Wish Hidden at Twilight

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away
meta.Episode: Episode6 — A Wish Hidden at Twilight
meta.Event Outline: Shiho feels a great sense of fulfillment after Leo/need successfully reaches its ticket quota and performs in perfect sync for the audience. She recalls the time she spent on her own back in junior high.

rows.Line: One week later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy JHS - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line:
No, I did it again!
I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line:
Haha. That part's so hard too.
Oh, that reminds me. I found this great shop the other day...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm gonna go get something to drink...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(We're not getting anything done.
All they do is talk and talk and talk...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Do they really think we're gonna be ready in time for the School Festival...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, I forgot to bring my wallet.
I'll just go back and...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line: As good as Hinomori is, she's a pain to deal with, don't you think...?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, she takes everything way too seriously, like a teacher coaching one of the sports clubs.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: To her credit, she wants to go pro, but the rest of us just want to have fun playing at the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line: Haha. I guess opposites don't really attract, huh?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: Anyway, the School Festival's coming up, so let's just make sure we're decent enough for that.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Was that your plan this whole time...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was under the impression that you all at least had some desire to play “decent”...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that's not really the case, is it...?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: No, um... My tongue just slipped and...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line: C-Can't you see that we're trying really hard? We might not be taking this as seriously as you, Hinomori, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whether or not you're taking this seriously isn't the issue here! At the very least, you're supposed to work on fixing your mistakes...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Otherwise, there's no way we'll ever be able to put on a good performance!

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line:
Who made you queen...?
You might be good, but that doesn't give you the right to berate us like that.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: H-Hold on, that was a little uncalled for, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: No, we're the ones who invited her to play with us, and she thanks us by ordering us around like this? Honestly, who does she think she is?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line: Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had no problem with you wanting to get in your last hurrah, but I'd like it if we could actually get things done during practice.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Members B & C
Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line:
Ugh...
We shouldn't have invited you...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, we're done talking...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: All we really wanted was someone to play bass for us, not someone who's going to cause us this much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line:
I agree...
I mean, Hinomori, this can't be easy for you either...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Why does it always have to end this way...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My day-to-day life's one thing, but a part of me held out hope that it wouldn't have to be like that when it came to music...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks.
It was fun while it lasted.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy JHS - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Long time no see, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
The School Festival's coming up too.
Is your band gonna be ready in time?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I quit...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Actually, no...
They kicked me out.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: They kicked you out? Why...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our goals in terms of music were too different and we could never get on the same page...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, I'm not sure I'd be able to get along with anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess it just means that I'm not cut out for playing in a band...
Honami!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did you have a committee meeting today, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
How'd club activities go for you today, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, the first years are coming along really nicely. They've been saying it's because I took the time to help them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They have? Good for you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's great and all...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you're still worried about Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There's no hope for me there either...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My unwillingness to bend is just gonna lead to more conflict.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's best for me to just be alone.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Hmm... Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: You always seem so lonely when you're by yourself, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: ...! That's because...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
It's written all over your face...
They're your friends, right...?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: The truth is, I really didn't know why I've been coming up here each day to play my guitar...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: When I first met you up here, Hinomori, my goal was just to kill time...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Part of it was because you looked so cool playing your bass. It was like nothing else mattered to you.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: You made me believe that I wouldn't have to feel the way I did if I started playing music...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
And playing my guitar did just that.
It put me at ease even when you weren't here.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But I still find myself coming up here...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I guess that means I don't actually want to be alone...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
You feel the same way, right, Hinomori?
You want someone by your side... You want your friends to be there with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's not possible...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But you're really gonna give up just like that...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: You're really just gonna toss that band and your friends aside...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Shiho, did you see?
We get to be in the same class during our first year!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm so glad we're all together...!
Right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're gonna have so much fun together, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I believe that we both have to find a way to move forward. We have to work to get out of whatever “ruts” we're in right now...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Just as I started playing my guitar, you tried your hand at joining a band.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: We have to keep making these changes one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: With that in mind, I have to change schools again next month...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
It's okay. I'm used to it now.
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
I can play music now.
So I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I plan on trying a little more at my next school.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Things might go well, but they might not. Whenever I feel sad or dejected, I'll just play my guitar...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But I don't plan on giving up. I'm gonna keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
So please, Hinomori...
Do the same.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I'll see you later...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait!

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Huh? What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
No...
I should be thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want someone to be there...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want them to be there...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But that's impossible...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But you're really gonna give up just like that...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
I wish I could...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Time to play my bass...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't go back now, and I have no way to move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is all I can really do for the time being...)
